atAGlance: Cánh gà nướng is grilled chicken wings, usually with charred skin, lemongrass or honeyed marinade, and dipping salt.
whatItIs: Cánh gà nướng are grilled chicken wings with smoky skin, often seasoned with lemongrass, honey, chili salt, or garlic depending on the shop.
howToEnjoy: Eat the wings hot from the grill, dipping lightly in lime-pepper salt if served. Ask for less chili before grilling because the heat can be rubbed into the skin.
howLocalsOrder: Order cánh gà nướng as a snack or shared plate. Say ít cay early, then ask for extra cucumber or dipping salt if you want to pace the heat.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, grilled wings often sit between street snack and beer-food: smoky, hands-on, and best eaten before the skin softens.
goodToKnow: The wings may be sweet, salty, or spicy depending on the marinade; ask less spicy before they go on the grill.
